sentences.sentence: It’ll be awkward getting cars in and out.
sentences.translation: 这样汽车就不好进出了。

sentences.sentence: The new financial arrangements were awkward to manage.
sentences.translation: 新的财务安排不好操作。

sentences.sentence: A good carpenter can make a cupboard to fit the most awkward space.
sentences.translation: 就算是再尴尬的空间，好木匠也能做一个合适的橱柜。

sentences.sentence: She was afraid he was going to ask an awkward question.
sentences.translation: 她担心他会问出不好回答的问题。

sentences.translation: 微弱的闪光

sentences.translation: 这个病毁掉了我的生活。

sentences.sentence: His career would be ruined.
sentences.translation: 他的事业将被毁掉。

sentences.sentence: All this mud’s going to ruin my shoes.
sentences.translation: 这泥巴会把我的鞋弄坏。

sentences.sentence: I added a dollop of vanilla ice cream to the pie.
sentences.translation: 我在馅饼中加了一块香草冰淇淋。

sentences.sentence: The city was swept up in the mood of exaltation.
sentences.translation: 该城被兴奋的情绪给席卷了。

sentences.sentence: She’d been pestered by reporters for days.
sentences.translation: 几天来她一直受到记者们的纠缠。

sentences.sentence: He merely lifted his eyebrows in placid deprecation of himself and everybody else.
sentences.translation: 他仅仅掀掀眉毛，平心静气地表示他自己和其他人的反对。

sentences.sentence: ...a highly autobiographical novel of a woman's search for identity.
sentences.translation: …一部关于一位女性寻找自我、自传性色彩浓厚的长篇小说。

sentences.sentence: The castles abut a natural forest.
sentences.translation: 与城堡毗邻的是一片天然森林。

sentences.sentence: Today people think of it as a "frontier province", which lie just below the Tibetan plateau and abut Vietnam, Laos and Burma.
sentences.translation: 今天，人们认为它是一个“边省”，这是在青藏高原及毗邻的越南、老挝和缅甸。

sentences.sentence: Frontier trade is not only the special form of the economic and trade among the abut countries' frontier regions, but also the important component part of the country's foreign trade.
sentences.translation: 边境贸易是毗邻国家边境地区之间经济、贸易活动的特殊形式，是国家对外经贸活动的重要组成部分。

sentences.sentence: Incense can attune the finite to the Infinite.
sentences.translation: 熏香可以使有限调谐至无限。

sentences.sentence: Now let us sit quietly and attune to our soul oversoul and source along with the earth mother and nature kingdoms.
sentences.translation: 现在，让我们静静地坐着，调谐向我们的灵魂、超灵和源头，以及地球母亲和自然界王国。

translations.translation: 分离的； 转折的， 反意的

sentences.sentence: Disjunctive words coexistence refers to two disjunctive words being used in a sentence.
sentences.translation: 转折词语的连用是指在同一个句子中两个表示转折意思的词语连用。

translations.translation: 极其重要的； 充满活力的

phrases.translation: 人口动态统计；生命的统计资料

sentences.sentence: The work she does is absolutely vital.
sentences.translation: 她所做的工作至关重要。

sentences.sentence: It is vital to be honest with your children.
sentences.translation: 对自己的孩子坦诚十分重要。

sentences.sentence: The tourist industry is of vital importance to the national economy.
sentences.translation: 旅游业对国家的经济至关重要。

sentences.sentence: Richardson played a vital role in the team’s success.
sentences.translation: 理查森对球队的成功起了极重要的作用。

sentences.sentence: The samples could give scientists vital information about long-term changes in the earth’s atmosphere.
sentences.translation: 这些样本可以给科学家提供关于地球大气长期变化的极其重要的资料。

phrases.translation: 海难救助作业，救助作业；财产抢救；补救手术

sentences.sentence: Divers hope to salvage some of the ship’s cargo.
sentences.translation: 潜水员希望能够抢救出船上部分货物。

sentences.sentence: He was enchanted with the euphonious music .
sentences.translation: 他陶醉在那悦耳的音乐中。

sentences.sentence: "The music wasn't bad, " Kathy replied. "I thought the violin and the piano produced a euphonious combination. "
sentences.translation: “音乐还不错，”凯西回答，“我觉得小提琴和钢琴演奏出了悦耳的合音。”

translations.translation: 吞食， 咽下； 抵制， 忍住

sentences.sentence: She quickly gulped her soda.
sentences.translation: 她很快地把汽水一饮而尽。

sentences.sentence: Insinuations about her mental state, about her capacity for delusion, were being made.
sentences.translation: 当时有对她的精神状态的影射——说她有妄想症的影射。

translations.translation: 奔放， 兴高采烈； 沸腾

sentences.sentence: She burst into the room with her usual ebullience.
sentences.translation: 她像往常一样兴高采烈地冲进了房间。

sentences.sentence: She burst into the room with her usual ebullience, and immediately started talking to everyone.
sentences.translation: 她像往常一样兴高采烈地冲进了房间，立刻跟大家攀谈起来。

phrases.translation: 时序逻辑；顺序逻辑；循序逻辑
序列分析；序贯分析；逐次分析

sentences.sentence: ...the sequential story of the universe.
sentences.translation: ...宇宙的变迁史。

text:
英语词汇 · GRE · 第 476 单元

exhaustive
音标：英 /ɪg'zɔːstɪv/  美 /ɪg'zɔstɪv/
adj.  彻底的， 无遗漏的
短语：exhaustive search — 穷举搜索
短语：exhaustive method — 穷举方法
例句：an exhaustive investigation
彻底的调查
例句：The list is by no means exhaustive.
清单一点也不详尽。

runic
音标：英 /'ruːnɪk/  美 /'rʊnɪk/
adj.  古北欧文字的； 神秘的

awkward
音标：英 /'ɔːkwərd/  美 /'ɔkwɚd/
adj.  笨拙的； 难用的； 不便的
例句：It’ll be awkward getting cars in and out.
这样汽车就不好进出了。
例句：The new financial arrangements were awkward to manage.
新的财务安排不好操作。
例句：A good carpenter can make a cupboard to fit the most awkward space.
就算是再尴尬的空间，好木匠也能做一个合适的橱柜。
例句：She was afraid he was going to ask an awkward question.
她担心他会问出不好回答的问题。

glimmer
音标：英 /'glɪmər/  美 /'ɡlɪmɚ/
v. 发微光
n.  摇曳的微光
例句：a weak glimmering light
微弱的闪光

ruin
音标：英 /'ruːɪn/  美 /'ruɪn/
v.  毁坏； 毁灭； 使破产
n. 废墟；祸根；毁坏
短语：in ruins — 成为废墟
短语：financial ruin — 经济损失
例句：This illness has ruined my life.
这个病毁掉了我的生活。
例句：His career would be ruined.
他的事业将被毁掉。
例句：All this mud’s going to ruin my shoes.
这泥巴会把我的鞋弄坏。

vanilla
音标：英 /və'nɪlə/  美 /və'nɪlə/
n.  香草， 香子兰
短语：vanilla ice cream — 香草冰淇淋
短语：vanilla bean — 香草豆荚
短语：vanilla extract — 香草精，香草萃
短语：plain vanilla — 单纯功能
例句：I added a dollop of vanilla ice cream to the pie.
我在馅饼中加了一块香草冰淇淋。

exaltation
音标：英 /ˌegzɔːl'teɪʃn/  美 /,ɛɡzɔl'teʃən/
n.  得意， 高兴
例句：The city was swept up in the mood of exaltation.
该城被兴奋的情绪给席卷了。

pester
音标：英 /'pestər/  美 /'pestə/
v.  纠缠， 烦扰
例句：She’d been pestered by reporters for days.
几天来她一直受到记者们的纠缠。

deprecation
音标：英 /ˌdeprɪ'keɪʃn/
n.  反对
例句：He merely lifted his eyebrows in placid deprecation of himself and everybody else.
他仅仅掀掀眉毛，平心静气地表示他自己和其他人的反对。

autobiographical
音标：英 /ˌɔːtəˌbaɪə'græfɪkl/  美 /,ɔtə,baɪə'græfɪkl/
adj.  自传的， 自传体的
例句：...a highly autobiographical novel of a woman's search for identity.
…一部关于一位女性寻找自我、自传性色彩浓厚的长篇小说。

abut
音标：英 /ə'bʌt/  美 /ə'bʌt/
v.  邻接， 毗邻
例句：The castles abut a natural forest.
与城堡毗邻的是一片天然森林。
例句：Today people think of it as a "frontier province", which lie just below the Tibetan plateau and abut Vietnam, Laos and Burma.
今天，人们认为它是一个“边省”，这是在青藏高原及毗邻的越南、老挝和缅甸。
例句：Frontier trade is not only the special form of the economic and trade among the abut countries' frontier regions, but also the important component part of the country's foreign trade.
边境贸易是毗邻国家边境地区之间经济、贸易活动的特殊形式，是国家对外经贸活动的重要组成部分。

attune
音标：英 /ə'tuːn/  美 /ə'tʊn; ə'tjʊn/
v.  使调和
例句：Incense can attune the finite to the Infinite.
熏香可以使有限调谐至无限。
例句：Now let us sit quietly and attune to our soul oversoul and source along with the earth mother and nature kingdoms.
现在，让我们静静地坐着，调谐向我们的灵魂、超灵和源头，以及地球母亲和自然界王国。

disjunctive
音标：英 /dɪs'dʒʌŋktɪv/  美 /dɪs'dʒʌŋktɪv/
adj.  分离的； 转折的， 反意的
短语：disjunctive normal form — 析取范式
例句：Disjunctive words coexistence refers to two disjunctive words being used in a sentence.
转折词语的连用是指在同一个句子中两个表示转折意思的词语连用。

vital
音标：英 /'vaɪtl/  美 /'vaɪtl/
adj.  极其重要的； 充满活力的
短语：vital part — 要害部位
短语：vital energy — 生命力
短语：vital force — n. 生机；生命力
短语：vital capacity — [医]肺活量
短语：vital function — 重要作用；生命机能
短语：vital statistics — 人口动态统计；生命的统计资料
短语：vital interest — 切身利益；重大利益
短语：vital point — 要点
短语：vital sign — 生命征；生命迹象
例句：The work she does is absolutely vital.
她所做的工作至关重要。
例句：It is vital to be honest with your children.
对自己的孩子坦诚十分重要。
例句：The tourist industry is of vital importance to the national economy.
旅游业对国家的经济至关重要。
例句：Richardson played a vital role in the team’s success.
理查森对球队的成功起了极重要的作用。
例句：The samples could give scientists vital information about long-term changes in the earth’s atmosphere.
这些样本可以给科学家提供关于地球大气长期变化的极其重要的资料。

salvage
音标：英 /'sælvɪdʒ/  美 /'sælvɪdʒ/
v. 抢救，海上救助
n.  海上救助
短语：salvage operation — 海难救助作业，救助作业；财产抢救；补救手术
短语：salvage charges — 救援费；海上打捞费
短语：salvage value — 残值
例句：Divers hope to salvage some of the ship’s cargo.
潜水员希望能够抢救出船上部分货物。

euphonious
音标：英 /juː'founiəs/  美 /ju'fonɪəs/
adj.  悦耳的
例句：He was enchanted with the euphonious music .
他陶醉在那悦耳的音乐中。
例句："The music wasn't bad, " Kathy replied. "I thought the violin and the piano produced a euphonious combination. "
“音乐还不错，”凯西回答，“我觉得小提琴和钢琴演奏出了悦耳的合音。”

gulp
音标：英 /gʌlp/  美 /ɡʌlp/
v.  吞食， 咽下； 抵制， 忍住
短语：gulp down — 狼吞虎咽地吃；忍住
例句：She quickly gulped her soda.
她很快地把汽水一饮而尽。

delusion
音标：英 /dɪ'luːʒn/  美 /dɪ'luʒn/
n.  欺骗； 幻想
例句：Insinuations about her mental state, about her capacity for delusion, were being made.
当时有对她的精神状态的影射——说她有妄想症的影射。

ebullience
音标：英 /ɪ'bʌliəns/
n.  奔放， 兴高采烈； 沸腾
例句：She burst into the room with her usual ebullience.
她像往常一样兴高采烈地冲进了房间。
例句：She burst into the room with her usual ebullience, and immediately started talking to everyone.
她像往常一样兴高采烈地冲进了房间，立刻跟大家攀谈起来。

sequential
音标：英 /sɪ'kwenʃl/  美 /sɪ'kwɛnʃl/
adj.  连续的， 一连串的
短语：sequential control — [计]顺序控制；时序控制
短语：sequential logic — 时序逻辑；顺序逻辑；循序逻辑
短语：sequential method — 序贯法；顺序法
短语：sequential analysis — 序列分析；序贯分析；逐次分析
短语：sequential circuit — [计]时序线路，程序电路
短语：sequential design — 序贯设计
短语：sequential sampling — 序贯抽样；顺序抽样
短语：sequential access — [计]顺序存取
例句：...the sequential story of the universe.
...宇宙的变迁史。
